import json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
r={"task":"vivoapk-rea-no-video-relay-enforcement","changed":False}
p=subprocess.run(["systemctl","show","jellyfin-pink.service","--property=PrivateNetwork,NoNewPrivileges,MemoryMax,RestrictAddressFamilies,IPAddressDeny"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=12)
for line in p.stdout.splitlines():
 if "=" not in line:continue
 key,v=line.split("=",1)
 if key in ("PrivateNetwork","NoNewPrivileges"):r[key]=v
 if key=="IPAddressDeny":r["IPAddressDenyConfigured"]=bool(v)
r["systemd_read_ok"]=p.returncode==0
count=0
for comm in Path("/proc").glob("[0-9]*/comm"):
 try:
  if comm.read_text().strip()!="ffmpeg":continue
  g=(comm.parent/"cgroup").read_text(errors="replace")
  if "jellyfin-pink.service" in g:count+=1
 except (OSError,PermissionError):pass
r["jellyfin_ffmpeg_processes_now"]=count
r["no_transcode_process_now"]=count==0
r["jellyfin_private_network_policy_enabled"]=r.get("PrivateNetwork","").lower() in ("yes","true")
print(json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True))
